# How much tax does your 1031 exchange defer, and by when must you act?

> Free 1031 like-kind exchange calculator for real estate investors: your 45-day identification and 180-day closing dates, cash and mortgage boot, recognized versus deferred gain, replacement property basis and the estimated tax you defer. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
